test_case: Customer submits a valid prepaid order, 20 bags of cement and 10 iron rods, automatic approval on
actual_result: Status awaiting_payment, 20 bags reserved, total ₦286,487.50

test_case: Customer resubmits the same items within 24 hours
actual_result: Held as draft with needs_confirmation true, after confirming sent to pending_approval with outcome warn

test_case: Order with no address, past date, quantity below minimum, quantity above stock, fractional quantity and unknown SKU
expected_result: All problems reported together, order blocked
actual_result: Six fail results in one response, status validation_failed

test_case: Customer uploads payment reference
actual_result: Status payment_verification

test_case: Finance confirms payment
expected_result: Order paid and released to warehouse
actual_result: Status paid

test_case: Warehouse finds 6 of 10 rods
expected_result: Shortage hold, customer asked to choose
actual_result: record_pick returned shortage_hold

test_case: Customer accepts partial delivery
expected_result: Order packed, refund raised for missing items plus tax
actual_result: Status packed, refund ₦30,960, delivery code visible to customer (1 reveal row)

test_case: Dispatch assigns a driver and the driver confirms pickup
actual_result: Status assigned, timeline shows out_for_delivery

test_case: Driver enters a wrong delivery code
actual_result: ok false, "Wrong code. Ask the customer to check it.", attempts_left 4

test_case: Driver enters the correct code
actual_result: ok true, status delivered

test_case: Finance pays the refund
actual_result: Credit note CN-9002 recorded (number advanced from CN-9001 in the first run because sequences are not rolled back)

test_case: Driver attempts to approve an order
actual_result: "You do not have permission to do this."

test_case: Warehouse adds a new product, then it is activated with no price
expected_result: Saved hidden from customers, activation refused
actual_result: Saved inactive at ₦0 with 40 on hand, 1 Admin notification, activation refused by check constraint products_active_needs_price

test_case: Dispatch attempts to add a product
actual_result: "You do not have permission to do this."

test_case: Customer account awaiting review tries to save an order
actual_result: save_draft refused, "Your account is not active, so you cannot place orders."

test_case: Customer account on hold tries to save an order
actual_result: save_draft refused, same message

test_case: Customer account blocked tries to save an order
actual_result: save_draft refused, same message

test_case: Draft saved while active, account put on hold, then submitted
expected_result: Blocked at submission by the customer status rule
actual_result: customer_status fail, "The customer account is not active.", status validation_failed

test_case: Admin raises the cement price from ₦9,500 to ₦9,900 between save_draft and submit_order
actual_result: pricing fail, "price changed from 9500.00 to 9900.00. Save the order again to update it.", status validation_failed

test_case: Customer uploads a sheet that quotes cement at an old price of ₦9,000
actual_result: Not blocked. The parser ignores the price column and the line was saved at the list price ₦9,500, so the customer is charged the correct price but is not told that the sheet price was out of date

test_case: Clean prepaid order under ₦500,000 with automatic approval on
actual_result: Status awaiting_payment, auto_approved true, events draft, submitted, awaiting_payment, total ₦335,077.50

test_case: Same kind of order with automatic approval off
actual_result: Status pending_approval, events draft, submitted, pending_approval, total ₦363,242.50

test_case: CSV import with one line whose SKU is not in the catalogue
expected_result: Matched lines imported, unmatched line reported to the customer, order blocked until fixed
actual_result: 2 lines imported, row 4 kept as unmatched, sku fail "Row 4: XYZ-404 - not in the catalogue", status validation_failed

test_case: CSV export of orders
expected_result: Orders list can be downloaded as CSV
actual_result: Not implemented. No order export exists in src or in the database functions

test_case: CSV export of the delivery log by Dispatch
actual_result: The application CSV code applied to the 3 rows delivery_log() returned for Dispatch produced a 12-column file with 3 data lines. The browser download step was not run because the live site is not reachable from the test container

test_case: Webhook sent on an order status change, payload logged
actual_result: Not implemented. No webhook table, trigger, edge function or pg_net extension exists
